articles.title: He Left Madrid Thirteen Years Ago. On Thursday, They Called Him Back.

articles.title: Another Dravid in India Colours. Rahul's Younger Son Anvay Gets His First National Call-Up.

articles.title: He Was Born in Delhi. He Delivered Parcels in Brisbane. Now He Could Play for Australia.

articles.nri_angle: Chaudhary's journey from Delhi domestic cricket to Australian international selection mirrors the broader diaspora experience of building a new life abroad, and his potential debut would end a 62-year wait for an India-born male cricketer in Australian colours.
